name: shopdemo-aqa-portfolio
description: A reproducible TypeScript and Playwright AQA portfolio with a controlled local application

scripts.setup: npm --prefix dummy-ecommerce ci && npm --prefix shopdemo-framework ci
scripts.browsers:install: cd shopdemo-framework && npx playwright install chromium firefox
scripts.check: npm --prefix shopdemo-framework run check && npm --prefix dummy-ecommerce run check
